hook.quote: Fighter jets are coming. But they won’t attack.

flow.quote: Even in a single announcement, the limits differ from one task to another.

surprise_structure.quote: The seat next door, “air-refueling support,” has not been booked under the same terms.

readability_pull.quote: Before going along with the force of the headline, check the subject.

no_unnatural_staging.quote: The seat next door, “air-refueling support,” has not been booked under the same terms.

hook.quote: Britain is sending fighter jets, but not to attack the other side.

flow.quote: If that were all, the story might end with “the jets are being sent to defend.”

surprise_structure.quote: The fighter jets are what draw the eye. But it was the refueling that showed how far Britain’s support reaches.

readability_pull.quote: Seen this way, the picture cannot be summed up with the word “defense.”

no_unnatural_staging.quote: We also need to ask which operations they support by providing fuel.

hook.quote: “We won’t attack.” If so, their role must be that of a “shield.”

flow.quote: That is because there is another kind of support: refueling in the air.

surprise_structure.quote: But there is one point we cannot overlook: what the aircraft receiving the fuel will do.

readability_pull.quote: The shorter the explanation, the more important it is not to miss what comes next.

no_unnatural_staging.quote: It fits neatly into the explanation box. But if we try to fit all of the UK’s support into that box, the lid will not close.

hook.quote: “Won’t attack.” At that one line, you were about to end the meeting in your head with the conclusion, “So Britain will only defend.”

flow.quote: At this point, you might want to say, “Right, they’re only on defense!” But the announcement mentions another task too.

surprise_structure.quote: It is like someone saying, “I won’t drive,” while helping put fuel in a car.

readability_pull.quote: Just putting one subject back can change how the news looks.

no_unnatural_staging.quote: This time, it’s the news detective’s turn to track down the subject.
